newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks seen rising on selective buying.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks seen rising on selective buying.

text.p: Share prices on the Caracas Stock Exchange were seen rising but at a less intense rhythm than in recent days, as foreign investors zeroed-in on selective stocks only, traders said.
"Stocks should rise, but probably less abruptly and only those that still have value," said one broker.

On Thursday the market's 19-share .IBC index rose 3.6 percent to close at 6,130.32 points, breaking its tenth successive record. Over 64 million shares traded at a total value of 11 billion bolivars ($24.6 million).
